TabTab 2.2.3 – Bug fixes

  • Fixed Command-Q and Command-W not working while searching
  • Fixed switcher entries lingering after closing windows or quitting apps, or disappearing when those actions were cancelled
  • Improved browser tab switching reliability and fixed incorrect tab ordering and selection when page titles keep changing, such as on YouTube

Thanks for using TabTab! ❤️

If you have any feedback, join our Discord and let us know!
